podcast.title: Death Details - March 17, 2024
podcast.body: Steve Harley died on March 17th, 2024, at the age of 73. He ultimately succumbed to cancer. "He died on March 17th at the age of 73, which is a lot older than most people expected. In the end, he would die of cancer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Frontman of Cockney Rebel
podcast.body: Steve Harley was widely recognized by British music fans as the distinctive frontman for the band Cockney Rebel. "He was a singer-songwriter best known to British music fans as the frontman for the band Cockney Rebel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Polio Diagnosis (1950s)
podcast.body: At the age of two in the 1950s, Steve Harley contracted polio. Doctors initially told his parents that he was not expected to live. "He contracted polio back in the 1950s at the age of two, and doctors told his parents that he would not live."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
